Instead of repeating these lines in every utility functions (Which will be done going forward).
Why not have a helper function in this file which will do this and then use that in every function? Will save LOCs by considerable number?

In some APIs we need to get the main system config JSON, some others we need to get the chassis specific JSONs using EEPROM path/inventory path. I think the helper function would be a layer on top of `l_configManager->getJsonObj()` and unnecessary re-direction.

What if the VPD file path is not found? Config Manager will return the master JSON and this code will fail.
We need to revisit config manager and avoid returning any JSON in case we don't find the path.
This fails the concept of single source of truth where it is returning JSON even when the path does not belong to that.

>What if the VPD file path is not found? Config Manager will return the master JSON and this code will fail.

This issue is there in the present implementation as well. The scope of this patch is to refactor the utility API to use `ConfigManager` to fetch JSON.
I think we can fetch the JSON from `ConfigManager` add a `.contains(i_vpdFilePath)` check inside this API
